during = callback()
    # Release the fence only after the observation callback returned: the
    # adapter resumes once the marker is gone and refuses at its bound when
    # the callback never completes, so the switch cannot continue while
    # evidence is still being collected.
    REPAIR_PAUSE_MARKER.unlink(missing_ok=True)
evidence.reason: At current line 2162, `during = callback()` runs outside any try/finally. If the callback raises, control leaves `cli_paused` before line 2167 unlinks `REPAIR_PAUSE_MARKER` and before line 2170 communicates with or terminates the child. Since the switch subprocess is started with `start_new_session=True`, the paused child and marker can remain outstanding. The helper already terminates/reaps on the marker-wait timeout path, so adding equivalent callback-failure cleanup is an ordinary correctness fix, not a new requirement.
